title: Sharding Prevents LLM Oversight Failures and Adversarial Exploitation
content:
arXiv:2608.06422v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Giving an LLM judge more compute does not necessarily make it check more requirements. When one call must return many verdicts, some decisions become weakly grounded in the evidence, even when that call receives the same token or tool budget as a panel of separate calls. Across expert-graded research replications, legal work, and clinical-trial assessments, agreement with experts falls as the number of verdicts per call grows. We identify sharding as the intervention that mitigates this failure in model-based oversight. Sharding partitions the requirements into smaller groups, assigns each group to a separate call, and aggregates the verdicts. Against a single call with the panel's full budget, sharding improves agreement while holding the model, evidence, total budget, and per-decision budget fixed. Overall, we find that a sharded weaker judge can outperform a more capable holistic judge and match that judge even when the latter receive
author: Victor Akinwande, J. Zico Kolter, Aran Nayebi
summary_zh: 论文指出 LLM 作为评审/裁判时，单次调用中需要输出的判定项越多，其与专家意见的一致性就越低——即使给予同等的 token 和工具预算，增加算力也无法弥补。作者提出「分片（sharding）」方法：将评估要求拆分成小组分派给多次独立调用再聚合结果，在科研复现、法律和临床试验评估三类任务中均显著提升准确性并增强对抗鲁棒性。这对设计 LLM 自动化审查、代码评审 Agent 和多条件校验工作流有直接的实践指导意义。

title: Meta is back with Muse Glimmer: local, agentic, multimodal, and open source
summary_zh: 文章介绍 Meta 回归开源阵营发布的 Muse Glimmer 模型，主打本地运行、智能体（agentic）能力、多模态与开源许可。对关注本地化 AI 编程助手、自建 agent 工作流的开发者有参考价值，可作为闭源云端模型之外的替代选项评估。

title: Watching Roku’s AI channel is like eating from a trough
content: The appeal of free ad-supported streaming television (FAST) channels has always been the way they make it easier to (re)discover classic films and series. But Roku's latest experiment in the FAST space has less to do with traditionally produced entertainment and is entirely focused on giving viewers access to a constant source of AI-generated content. title: Making Knowledge Distillation Cheap Enough to Run at Scale
summary_zh: 文章探讨如何将知识蒸馏的成本降到足以规模化运行的水平，属于 LLM 模型训练与优化实践范畴。对于需要自建小模型、降低推理成本的团队有参考价值，但与 Claude Code 日常编码工作流的直接关联较弱。

title: v2.1.227
content: What's changed Fixed feature flags being evaluated without the user's subscription tier when a session started with an expired login token, which could wrongly prompt Max plan users to enable usage credits for Fable Fixed every Bash command failing under claude-code-action with allowed_non_write_users on GitHub-hosted runners Fixed /tui bringing back a conversation that had been rewound to before its first message Improved slash-command menu: blue now marks only the selected row, matched characters are bolded instead of recolored, and emoji or accented names keep their glyphs Improved performance: fewer event-loop stalls on file-not-found suggestions and at-mention size checks
author: ashwin-ant
